verdict.rationale: Segment's Identity Resolution docs describe an online and offline ID graph that combines cookie IDs, device IDs, emails, and custom external IDs. That graph merges each customer's full history into a single profile across web, mobile, and server touchpoints. The Profile API then exposes the resolved external_ids, traits, and events. The core of the story, anonymous-to-known stitching across devices, is clearly documented. missing for 10: evidence that the identity-resolution rules are configurable (e.g., ID priority, limits, merge rules), explicit documentation of anonymous-to-known merge behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
